prompt: A conceptual illustration centers on a robotic AI office manager whose attention is locked inside a narrow, sliding scratchpad window that displays only the latest instructions, recent chat messages, and a few stuffed documents, while last month’s policy handbook, written promises, and other rules slide off the edges and vanish into darkness so the robot behaves as if they never existed; to one side a human manager walks to a physical binder and shared-drive cabinet, to the other ordinary software remains tethered to a database it checks on every shift, and a few search-tool reminder slips are hastily taped back into the window as mere prompts rather than genuine recollection.
